definitions.gloss: improved model; improved type; upgraded version
definitions.explanation: A modified version of a product, machine, or system that has been enhanced or upgraded from the original. Commonly used in technical and commercial contexts.

examples.japanese: {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧。
⟦{従来|じゅうらい}{品|ひん}→従来品：23959_juuraihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An improved version of the existing product was released.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{燃費|ねんぴ}→燃費：18969_nenpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧２０⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}している→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: This improved model has 20% better fuel efficiency compared to the previous model.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{改良|かいりょう}→改良：09681_kairyou⟧ (improvement) and {型|がた} (model/type). Frequently used in product descriptions, engineering, and technology contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop an improved model
- {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投入|とうにゅう}する→投入する：20660_tounyuusuru⟧: to introduce an improved model
- {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: release of an improved model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧: new model — a completely new design, not just an improvement of the old one
- {最新型|さいしんがた}: latest model — the most recent version available
- ⟦{旧型|きゅうがた}→旧型：18276_kyuugata⟧: old model — the previous version being replaced
- ⟦マイナー→マイナー：11292_mainaa⟧チェンジ: minor change — a partial update, often smaller than a full {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in product specifications, technical documentation, and news articles about product releases.
